content_quality.app_visit_caveat: App visits count clicks through to app.growthbook.io. They are NOT signups and must never be described as such. Every app link targets the bare root, so a signup cannot be distinguished from a login, and no new-vs-returning dimension is available. Measured against real signup counts, at most ~7% of app visits became a signup, so the large majority are existing users logging in. Product and feature pages sit on the path existing users take to reach the app, which inflates their app-visit rate relative to blog content that draws first-time visitors from search.
